metaTitle: Custom Recycled Cotton T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom recycled cotton t shirts for eco-friendly branding. Bulk orders with screen printing or embroidery. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled cotton t shirts reduce textile waste while delivering the softness and breathability your team expects. Whether you choose a tri-blend like the Allmade® Tee or a 50/50 cotton-poly blend from Port & Company, each shirt diverts fabric from landfills. Ideal for company uniforms, event giveaways, or retail merchandise, these shirts accept screen printing and embroidery beautifully. Ordering custom recycled cotton t shirts signals your commitment to sustainability without sacrificing comfort or durability.
